name: 雾蓝云絮羽感防晒软管款

category.leaf: 轻薄空气感面部防晒霜（软管装）

description: 雾蓝三阶云絮场配白色羽绒与哑光卡纸台，突出面部防晒霜的轻薄空气感

styleLock.direction: airy cool skincare commerce built on layered haze-blue fields and white down
styleLock.backgroundSystem: three horizon-free haze strata of one cool family only: frost white #F7FBFE upper haze, cloud-blue #DCEAF3 mid field, deeper mist #BFD7EA base band; never a sky, never a scenery, never a stone ledge, plaster sweep, sand bed, ceramic board, louvered shadow stripe or tinted filter flag with a colour pool
styleLock.lightingSystem: all-around diffused mist light with a soft fill from the upper left or upper right, weightless contact shadows, one satin highlight along the tube shoulder; no hard-edged shadow stripe, no cone beam, no burnt-in highlight
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte coated paperboard risers and sheets in cloud-blue #DCEAF3 and deeper mist #BFD7EA, plus a frost-white #F7FBFE down-filled cushion pad; loose white goose-down plumes are the only soft goods
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; in-image Chinese only as short placeholder rails and chips set in deep petrol ink #1B3E56 with a mist-blue #6E9BD6 leading rule; no script, no handwriting, no retro or cartoon lettering, no numerals anywhere
styleLock.iconSystem: none beyond thin-line leading rules and blank rounded chips in mist-blue #6E9BD6; no sun disc, ray burst, shield, clock, hourglass, umbrella, droplet, bubble or ball-and-stick molecule glyphs
styleLock.presentationRules: the tube keeps one stance and one scale across every screen: standing on its flat crimped cap end for product views, laid with its cap beside it only in the closing flat lay; the label face is never occluded by down plumes or props
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #F7FBFE, #DCEAF3, #BFD7EA, #6E9BD6 and #1B3E56
no warm cast and no beige, sand, gold, coral or amber tone entering any frame
no stone ledge, cotton cloth, plaster sweep, louvered shadow stripe, fine sand ridges, shells, ceramic tile, translucent filter flag or tinted light pool as staging
no sun, ray, shield, clock, hourglass, umbrella, droplet, bubble or molecule graphics, and no band-chart or spectrum-row diagram
no protection factors, durations, percentages, net-content figures, certificates, test reports or lab data rendered anywhere in the image
no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no numerals or circled numbers in the layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy cool skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of frost white #F7FBFE, cloud-blue #DCEAF3, deeper mist #BFD7EA, mist-blue accent #6E9BD6 and deep petrol ink #1B3E56; three horizon-free haze strata stand in for any scenery or backdrop photograph; all-around diffused mist light with a soft upper fill, weightless contact shadows and one satin highlight along the tube shoulder; matte coated paperboard risers and sheets plus a frost-white down-filled cushion pad as the only surfaces; loose white goose-down plumes as the only prop; one modern geometric sans-serif family with thin-line leading rules and blank rounded chips, no icons and no numerals; stable tube stance and scale with the label face never occluded; no warm cast, no stone or plaster staging, no louvered shadow stripe, no sand or shell texture, no filter flag or tinted light pool, no sun-ray or shield graphics, no protection factors or measured figures, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.

provenance.notes: 源为 6 张 800x1200 详情切片，逐屏事实：第 1 屏软管直立于浅蓝虚化云底，身后一枚白色圆形光晕盘、两侧细线射线、顶部拉丁字标与暖橙标题行；第 2 屏大标题加一张圆角白卡内的横向分段区间线图（按波段分栏、三行区间对比）；第 3 屏软管居左、右侧三行带大号编号数字的卖点栏（每行标题加两行小字）；第 4 屏浅蓝云底上的球棍状分子网格与两行标题；第 5 屏上半为链状分子图案与小标题、下半为暖橙等式大标题加两根白色羽绒；第 6 屏软管直立于白色羽绒环中央，左下角一枚黑色角标与二维码。品类判定：夹名「洗护」仅为参考、不采纳，按图判定为护肤个护/面部护理；硬证据是管体为扁尾旋盖软膜管、膏体为面霜质地，无按压喷头与气罐结构（排除喷雾与定妆类彩妆件），三行诉求均以面部为对象并含抗光措辞，全片无任何身体部位、四肢涂抹或沙滩户外实景（排除护肤个护/身体护理），无着色彩妆步骤与刷具（排除美妆彩妆）。已剥离：管身与顶部的拉丁字母字标与系列名、管体上的太阳形指数字标、首屏与卖点屏出现的防护指数、小时数、阻隔率百分比与容量数字、第 3 屏的编号数字与标题原句、第 4 与第 5 屏的复配成分名称与项数、第 6 屏左下角会员角标与二维码、原平台与店铺字样；这些一律不进模版，改为 {selling_point_n} 与 {callout_n} 或空白卡位，且全套禁止以太阳射线、盾牌、时钟、沙漏等图形暗示防护等级，禁止以球棍分子或网格图案暗示成分与机理。与「护肤个护/面部护理」段四件既有防晒的逐条区隔：其一，水薄轻透呼吸感面部防晒乳款为石台加棉布配日光橙圆环（云母白、青绿、日光橙、墨青四色体系），本套改为三阶无地平线雾蓝云场与羽绒软垫，无石台、无棉布、无圆环，且完全不出现任何暖橙与纯白；其二，硬边帘影钢青防晒霜软管款为固定角度百叶帘硬边投影带（青灰石灰白、钢青灰、深海军墨、珊瑚四色体系），本套光位为全向柔雾散光、画面内不存在任何投影带或硬边阴影图形，色板为冰蓝阶而非钢青灰，标签元件为霜雾白横栏而非珊瑚色胶囊；其三，细沙纹硬光金色泵瓶防晒霜款为细沙纹掠射台面配贝壳长影（沙白、驼金、海墨、金调四色体系），本套台面为哑光涂层卡纸与羽绒软垫，无沙纹、无贝壳、无掠射硬光、无金调；其四，冷瓷滤光台防晒细雾款为冷瓷浅绿台配直立半透明滤光旗与染色光池（霜瓷浅绿、玉青、滤光柑黄、墨玉绿四色体系），本套色相为蓝系而非绿系，无直立旗板、无染色光池、无柑黄强调，道具为羽绒与卡纸阶梯。机位体系亦不同：本套为正平行视线、轻微 3/4、高 45 度下望、微距正平行、低角度仰视、90 度侧面、正俯视七种机位，与四件以直平行与特写为主的配置不同，并含本段唯一的羽绒仰拍镜。角色序列 HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>DETAIL>SCENE>COMPARISON>CTA 与本段任意一件均不同序。此外与库内旧件的天空蓝加纯白加暖橙防晒系（以纯白为底、暖橙为强调）区分：本套全场不使用纯白色值，也不使用任何暖色强调色。色板查重结论：#F7FBFE、#DCEAF3、#BFD7EA、#6E9BD6、#1B3E56 五个 hex 已逐个以 grep 在全库 *.suite.json 中检索，命中数均为 0（本文件自身除外）。源屏仅 6 张，故取 7 镜，未凑数。
